name: appstore-mcp
description: Manage the Apple App Store Connect API from Claude: apps, in-app purchases, subscriptions, pricing, App Review submission, TestFlight, provisioning, analytics, and more (126 tools).
long_description: A Rust MCP server exposing the Apple App Store Connect API. Curated tools for apps & metadata, in-app purchases, subscriptions and their offers, pricing & availability, App Store versions, App Review submission, TestFlight, provisioning & signing, asset uploads, promoted purchases, customer reviews, phased release, users, in-app events, Xcode Cloud, and analytics reports (including downloading and parsing report data), plus two generic JSON:API tools that reach any other endpoint. Every tool is annotated read-only/destructive so the client knows what needs confirming, and an optional read-only mode withholds writes entirely. Authenticates with a short-lived ES256 JWT from your App Store Connect API key.

asc_issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
asc_issuer_id.description: Your App Store Connect issuer UUID (Users and Access -> Integrations -> App Store Connect API).

asc_private_key_path.title: Private key (.p8)
asc_private_key_path.description: The AuthKey_XXXXXX.p8 file you downloaded when creating the API key.

asc_read_only.title: Read-only mode
asc_read_only.description: Serve only tools that cannot modify your account. Nothing can be created, changed, submitted, or deleted.

asc_tool_discovery.title: Tool discovery mode
asc_tool_discovery.description: Expose search, inspect, and call tools instead of all operation schemas.
